lines.text: Jesus says no one knows that day or hour except the Father alone.
Jesus says His coming will be like the days of Abraham, when people were oblivious until the flood came.
Of two men in the field and two women grinding at the mill, one is taken and the other left.
The master puts the faithful servant in charge of all his possessions when he finds him feeding the household.
The wicked servant says his master will be away a long time, but the master comes on a day he expects.

wrong_details.true: a day he does not expect
